import hashlib,io,json,os,subprocess,sys,unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
p=Path('scripts/gmyhf_review_fixes.py');original=p.read_text();base='tests.test_gmyhf_review_fixes.ReviewRulesTests.'
cases=[
('N改成N减一',"return str(n).encode() + (b'\\r'","return str(n-1).encode() + (b'\\r'",'test_three_flavors_repair_only_removes_legacy_header'),
('重排数量表',"+ separator + body","+ separator + b' '.join(body.split())",'test_three_flavors_repair_only_removes_legacy_header'),
('忽略CRLF',"(b'\\r' if first.endswith(b'\\r') else b'')","b''",'test_three_flavors_repair_only_removes_legacy_header'),
('允许全零袋子','assert any(v for row in rows for v in row)','assert True','test_three_flavors_repair_rejects_unreviewed_schema'),
('错误旧口味参数','header[2:] == [1, 2]','header[2:] == [2, 1]','test_three_flavors_repair_only_removes_legacy_header'),
('放宽数量表列数','len(row) == 3 and','len(row) >= 2 and','test_three_flavors_repair_rejects_unreviewed_schema'),
('忽略多余数量行','len(lines) == n + 1','len(lines) >= n + 1','test_three_flavors_repair_rejects_unreviewed_schema'),
('放宽形状数上界','2 <= n <= 10**5','2 <= n <= 10**6','test_three_flavors_repair_rejects_unreviewed_schema')]
results=[]
try:
 for name,old,new,test in cases:
  assert original.count(old)==1,(name,original.count(old));p.write_text(original.replace(old,new))
  run=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3.11','-B','-m','unittest',base+test],capture_output=True,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'))
  assert run.returncode!=0,name
  results.append({'mutation':name,'detected':True,'exit_code':run.returncode});p.write_text(original)
finally:p.write_text(original)
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()));from tests.test_gmyhf_review_fixes import ReviewRulesTests
entry=next(e for e in json.loads(Path('collab/gmyhf-pending-batch10-review.json').read_text())['entries'] if e['global_number']==31239)
source=entry['authored_reference']['source'].split('import sys\nsys.stdout.write')[0].replace('if j != i','if True');ns={};exec(source,ns)
with patch.object(ReviewRulesTests,'reference',return_value=ns['single_pair']):
 result=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=io.StringIO()).run(ReviewRulesTests('test_three_flavors_reference_against_adversarial_draws'));assert not result.wasSuccessful()
results.append({'mutation':'允许同一形状配对','detected':True,'failures':len(result.failures)})
s=Path(__file__).read_text();Path('collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch13-mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps({'batch':13,'results':results,'procedure_source':s,'procedure_sha256':hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print(len(results),'种变异检出，源码已恢复')
